versions.changelog:
Initial public release of the Revenue Operations (RevOps) Engine skill.

- Provides a comprehensive RevOps assessment and foundational audit template.
- Introduces a RevOps maturity model across data, process, technology, analytics, alignment, and enablement.
- Details best practices for unified revenue data architecture, object models, and attribution model selection.
- Defines universal B2B SaaS funnel stages, conversion benchmarks, and actionable scoring templates.
- Includes diagnostic rules and operational SLAs to drive cross-functional revenue alignment.
